name: Hyatt Regency Phnom Penh
short_description: A 247-room Hyatt Regency near the Royal Palace and National Museum, with a Regency Club and a rooftop restaurant, FiveFive.
ai_summary: Hyatt Regency Phnom Penh sits in the heart of the capital, a 5-10 minute walk from the Royal Palace and National Museum of Cambodia. Guests consistently praise the polite, warmly personalized service -- returning guests report staff remembering their preferences -- along with spacious rooms, an excellent breakfast, and the FiveFive rooftop restaurant's panoramic views. The hotel blends colonial-style public spaces with a modern room tower, and while most experiences are strongly positive, dining prices run notably higher than local restaurants outside the hotel and a few reviews note inconsistent bell-staff assistance.

research_highlights: Guests describe top service and ambiance, with the property in superb condition throughout

faqs.question: Is Hyatt Regency Phnom Penh close to the Royal Palace?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's a 5-10 minute walk from the Royal Palace of Cambodia and the National Museum, putting the city's main historic sights within easy reach on foot rather than requiring a taxi.

faqs.question: Is dining at Hyatt Regency Phnom Penh expensive?
faqs.answer: It runs notably higher than local restaurants just outside the hotel, according to reviewers, though the FiveFive rooftop restaurant and Market Cafe's breakfast draw consistent praise for quality -- worth budgeting for if dining on-site regularly.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Hyatt Regency Phnom Penh
reviews.summary: Rates the hotel 4.4/5, praising the prime location near major attractions and excellent fitness and pool facilities, but notes weaker bell-staff assistance and dining prices notably higher than local restaurants outside the hotel.
